column1: # The checks of shell/variable-get.nsh, the boot of shell-variable-get: get decodes Timeout and
# BootOrder, and the default firmware has no SecureBoot or SetupMode. It shows Boot0001 and
# Boot0002 as the firmware's boot manager logged them when it tried them before the shell, the
# first, "UEFI Misc Device", in vain; Key0000, F2 to Boot0000, whose CRC matches; and ConOut as

column3: .variable == "BootOrder-8be4df61-93ca-11d2-aa0d-00e098032b8c" and .attributes == 7 and (.value | length) > 0 and all(.value[]; test("^Boot[0-9A-F]{4}$"))

.value as $v | .variable == "Boot0001-8be4df61-93ca-11d2-aa0d-00e098032b8c" and ($v.device_paths | length) == 1 and ($firmware | any(startswith("BdsDxe: failed to load Boot0001 \"\($v.description)\" from \($v.device_paths[0]): ")))

.value as $v | .variable == "Boot0002-8be4df61-93ca-11d2-aa0d-00e098032b8c" and ($v.device_paths | length) == 1 and ($firmware | any(. == "BdsDxe: loading Boot0002 \"\($v.description)\" from \($v.device_paths[0])"))
